description: Publish a validated drop at a coordinate. The drop must conform to the closed schema: fixed enums, numbers, booleans, URLs, hashes, ISO timestamps, bounded identifiers -- no free text exists anywhere in the protocol. Requires a did:key author, an ed25519 signature over the canonical content, and a proof-of-work nonce (difficulty 18 bits). PoW is ALWAYS caller-computed -- the server never solves it (that would let callers offload the anti-spam cost). Pass private_key and the server signs for this call only (the key is never stored). Returns the drop id and Stamp attestation.

drop.description: The drop object per the schema: v, coord, kind, subject, claim, confidence, observed_at, expires_at, author, refs, pow, sig.

private_key.description: Optional. base64url ed25519 seed for the drop's author DID -- the server signs for this call only, never stores it. You must still supply a valid pow. WARNING: sends your seed to the server -- only use this on a local stdio server or a TLS endpoint you trust.

name: drop
